verdict.summary: A shadow (no-order) Track 1 route can be built now. An order-sending route is blocked on four design decisions, none of which is a defect in the current system - each is a single-route assumption that a second route breaks.

blockers.title: One IB Gateway login is one position book; no account dimension exists
evidence: global_index/ibkr_broker.py:496 IBKRBroker.__init__(host, port, client_id, bar_duration, _raw_fetcher) - no account parameter
global_index/ibkr_broker.py:1038 get_equity() reads NetLiquidation from ib.accountValues() unfiltered
global_index/run_scheduler.py:684-702 records that same-symbol netting is exactly why STRESS_MID's 10:20 cron was disabled
blockers.failure_mode: legacy LONG 1 + Track1 SHORT 1 on the same symbol nets to 0 at IBKR; B3 sees two file rows against broker x0 -> B3 MISMATCH -> entries HALT for both routes
blockers.note: a different client_id does NOT solve this - it changes who may cancel an order, not whose positions are counted
blockers.decision_required: separate IBKR account/login for Track 1, or Track 1 stays order-free until legacy is retired

blockers.title: The 10:20 to 14:05 ET no-run invariant forbids the Track 1 windows on the legacy entry point
evidence: global_index/signal_layer.py:97 diff_desired_vs_held, exit loop at lines 118-121
_mark_held_unchanged (signal_layer.py:130) is never called for the stress cluster
blockers.failure_mode: a run_live_day slot inside that band closes stress positions on the next run; recorded case +$12,850 -> -$450, silent
blockers.decision_required: Track 1 needs its own entry-point script and its own signal layer; a --clusters flag on run_live_day would breach the invariant on the first slot

blockers.title: Track 1's windows open before the day's own pre-flight
evidence: global_index/run_scheduler.py:802-846 fail-closed on a missing pre-flight flag
Calm A is 10:00 ET; Stress is 10:35-12:30 ET
blockers.failure_mode: both windows must use prev_preflight=True, so the freshest data update available is 13:45 ET the PREVIOUS business day - a different data-freshness contract from the one every Track 1 backtest number was produced under
blockers.decision_required: accept D-1 13:45 as the Track 1 data contract and record it in the invariants, or add a second pre-flight before 10:00 with its own fail-closed reasoning

blockers.title: Quantity has no cluster dimension and Stress-MNQ is 7 lots
evidence: global_index/live_decision.py decide_day reads contracts_by_inst the same way
global_index/run_live_day.py contracts_by = {n: 1 for n in list(BASKET) + [NKD_INST]}
blockers.failure_mode: Track 1 wants MNQ=1 under roska4_swing and MNQ=7 under roska4_stress on the same day; there is no key that expresses that, so it fails silently as 'entered 1 instead of 7'
blockers.decision_required: make size a property of the candidate (t['contracts']) or wrap the runner for Track 1
